IC1: - Women [AND] with chronic anovulation [OR] or oligomenorrhea defined as spontaneous intermenstrual periods of greater than [OR] or equal to 45 days or a total of less than or equal to 8 menses per year.
IC2: - Women [AND] with Hyperandrogenism defined as a total testosterone greater than 50 ng/dL [OR] or a free androgen index greater than 10.
IC3: - Women [AND] with Polycystic Ovaries on Ultrasound defined as either 12 or more follicles measuring 2-9 mm in diameter [OR] or increased ovarian volume greater than 10 cm.
